# CLA signature record

This file records who has accepted the
[AgentOS Contributor Licence Agreement](CLA.md), which version they accepted,
and when.

It is kept in the repository on purpose. No third-party service holds this
data, nothing is sent anywhere, and the history of this file is the audit
trail: every entry is a commit, signed off and reviewable like any other.

## How an entry gets here

1. A first-time contributor comments on their pull request:
   `I have read the AgentOS Contributor Licence Agreement (CLA v1.0) and I agree to it.`
2. The maintainer adds a row below, in the same pull request or immediately
   after merging it.

Contributors sign once, not per pull request.

## Scope

This record starts with CLA v1.0, adopted 2026-09-07.

Contributions merged **before** that date were submitted under the project's
then-current inbound terms (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`) and are governed by those
terms. They are not retroactively covered by this agreement, and no entry is
backfilled for them. See [`../AUTHORS`](../AUTHORS).
